name: Happy Go Licky
label: Dischord
lede: Four members of Rites of Spring came back in spring 1987 with tape loops, half-improvised songs and no studio. They played seven shows, all in Washington, and broke up on New Year's Day.

eras.title: Rites of Spring, rewired
eras.text: After One Last Wish, the Rites of Spring lineup regrouped without the Rites of Spring songs. Dischord calls it an entirely different musical program with a much more experimental focus, and the band kept it inside Washington.

years.cap: Happy Go Licky at the 9:30 Club, Washington, 1987
years.h: The Rites of Spring four come back under a new name
years.p: [[Guy Picciotto|f8200cea-b5e9-4145-b5a5-1d0838f2c288]] and [[Eddie Janney|323dd1dd-23e4-45ce-9aa9-c5492096d604]] play guitar and sing, [[Mike Fellows|58a7226f-e06a-4728-82a5-ddc4443025a4]] plays bass and [[Brendan Canty|8b505ef0-c5a7-4deb-bc32-27c882f3c40e]] drums. Janney also runs tapes.
years.xp:
Fellows, Rites of Spring's original bassist, had sat out [[One Last Wish|94f18045-7fe2-41df-bf24-0bed21c88eb8]]. Here the old unit is whole again. Dischord credits Janney with guitar, tapes and vocals, which says a lot about where this was headed.

Wikipedia dates the band to spring 1987, and says it never entered a studio.

years.h: Tape loops, sound effects, songs made up on stage
years.p: Per Wikipedia, many Happy Go Licky songs were largely or entirely improvised, with unusual structures.
years.xp: Wikipedia describes the shows as far more experimental than Rites of Spring, with tape loops and sound effects worked into the set. This 13 September 1987 set at the 9:30 Club runs about seven minutes.

years.cap: Flyer for Happy Go Licky at D.C. Space, 27 November 1987
years.h: Seven shows, and Happy Go Licky never leaves D.C.
years.p: Dischord's count: three at D.C. Space, three at the 9:30 Club, one at Food for Thought.
years.xp: The flyer for the 27 November D.C. Space show reads "Happy Go Licky are back," with Bands of Death on the bill.

years.h: Canty and Picciotto are already in [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]]
years.p: Canty drums at Fugazi's first show that September, and Picciotto is soon singing with [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]]. Happy Go Licky keeps going to the end of the year anyway.

years.h: "Cutthroat Answer" live at the 9:30 Club, September 13, 1987
yt: "Cutthroat Answer" live at the 9:30 Club, September 13, 1987

eras.title: One last night, a thousand copies
eras.text: Happy Go Licky ended on a D.C. club stage, sharing the night with friends. What survived was a live record on Guy Picciotto's own Peterbilt label, pressed once and gone.

years.cap: Happy Go Licky at the 9:30 Club, Washington
years.h: It ends on New Year's Day at the 9:30 Club
years.p: Happy Go Licky breaks up on the first day of 1988. Three plays its own last show on the same bill, and [[Bastro|cfc5b1bf-a46c-4504-bcb6-a820416a1894]] plays too, per Wikipedia.
years.xp: Dischord says Three and Happy Go Licky played their last shows together that night. For Picciotto and Canty, the Rites of Spring chapter that started in 1984 closes here, and what follows runs through Fugazi.

years.p: Happy Go Licky collects six songs from live tapes on Picciotto's own Peterbilt Records. Dischord says it is long gone.

eras.title: Built from the live tapes
eras.text: Nearly a decade after the last show, Dischord went back to the live tapes and built the only full document of the band.

yt: Pastel Blue Eyes and Ansol, 9:30 Club, 13 Sept 1987
years.h: Will Play gathers 21 songs from the live tapes
years.p: The six from the 1988 Peterbilt 12-inch, plus fifteen unreleased recordings. Dischord No. 109, mixed by [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]] and the band.
years.xp: The tracklist is its own kind of evidence: alternate versions of Pastel Blue Eyes, Suzuki, Casing and Ansol, plus a closing D.I.Y. Ansol. For a band that improvised, one take of a song was never the whole story.

years.h: Fellows goes on to [[Royal Trux|87e27246-8c40-407f-bfb3-5dc416557eeb]] and more
years.p: Per Dischord, Mike Fellows plays in Little Baby, Getaway Car, Royal Trux, [[Air Miami|fdc1eb7c-3ad2-4c4a-abf7-81b42f56b989]] and Mighty Flashlight. Picciotto and Canty stay in Fugazi.
